generation: Run the pinned Python teratts_ruaccent.py with local-only assets from the pinned TeraTTSv2 revision. precedence.manual_span: Any + in one <ru>...</ru> span bypasses all automatic RUAccent processing for that span.
precedence.manual_word: The internal accent stage never adds another marker to a word already containing +.
precedence.other_spans: Manual stress in one Russian span does not disable automatic processing in another span. English spans are never changed.
